refactorExperience.title:
Messy code slows you down.
Clean code moves you forward.
refactorExperience.description: What looks like a small refactor often removes hidden complexity. We turn fragile, duplicated logic into clean, reliable systems that are easier to scale, maintain, and build on.

before.title: What is wrong in the first version

items.detailsMixedTogether: The same bookings list is looped several times for related work.
items.defaultsRepeated: The pricing logic is repeated instead of being reused.
items.changesFeelRisky: Even a small pricing change could require edits in multiple places.

items.fieldsAreCleaner: A named breakfast constant removes the magic number and keeps pricing easier to change.
items.goalsCollectedOnce: Destructuring and one loop make the code shorter and easier to scan.
items.easierToUpdate: Fewer operations and clearer types make the function safer to change later.

intro.label: Simple example
intro.title: A booking total function before and after refactoring
intro.description: The first version loops over the same bookings several times and repeats pricing logic. The refactored version keeps one clear flow, uses a named constant and is easier to maintain.

chips.outcome: Clean TypeScript with one clear flow

beforePanel.helper: Works today. Hard to change tomorrow.

afterPanel.helper: Cleaner now. Easier to extend later.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: We keep data collection minimal and only gather the information needed to reply to inquiries and deliver our services.
privacy.collection: When you contact us, we may store your name, email address, company details and project information you choose to share.
privacy.usage: We use that information to communicate about potential work, provide estimates, deliver contracted services and improve how we operate.
privacy.retention: We retain project and contact information only as long as it is reasonably necessary for business, legal and operational purposes.

terms.title: Terms of engagement
terms.intro: Project scope, pricing, delivery milestones and responsibilities are confirmed in writing before work begins.
terms.scope: Any timeline or deliverable depends on timely feedback, access and approvals from the client side.
terms.delivery: Unless otherwise agreed, intellectual property transfers to the client after all outstanding invoices for the project have been paid.
terms.liability: Our liability is limited to the value of the services delivered under the active agreement, to the extent permitted by law.
